boxplot.description: Whisker-and-box summary of a numeric column's spread per category — min, quartiles, median and max.
boxplot.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters to summarise as box plots.

violin.description: Mirrored density curves comparing how a numeric column is distributed across groups.
violin.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters to build density profiles.

ridgeline.description: Overlapping density ridges comparing a numeric column across ordered groups.
ridgeline.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters to build density profiles.

scatterBubble.description: Two numeric columns as points, with an optional bubble size and a trend line.
scatterBubble.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters for the selected columns.

hexbin.description: Hex-binned density of two numeric columns, shaded by how many rows fall in each tile.
hexbin.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters to bin.

correlationMatrix.description: Pearson correlation between selected numeric columns, from strong positive to strong negative.
correlationMatrix.emptyBody: Select at least two numeric columns with matching rows.

parallelCoordinates.description: Each record as a line across several normalised numeric axes, coloured by a category.
parallelCoordinates.emptyBody: No rows matched the filters across the selected axes.

activityFeed.description: A running feed of who did what across your workspace, newest first.
activityFeed.emptyBody: Actions across your workspace will show up here.

notificationFeed.description: Grouped notifications with unread state, filters, and inline actions.

realtimeFeed.description: A live event stream that prepends new items as they arrive.
realtimeFeed.emptyBody: Live events will stream in as they happen.

timelineVertical.description: A vertical timeline of events, releases, incidents, or run steps.
timelineVertical.emptyBody: Events will appear on this timeline as they happen.

unreadBadge.description: A count pill showing unread items, synced with feed state.

calendarMonth.description: A month grid of scheduled events with per-day chips and month navigation.
calendarMonth.emptyBody: Scheduled events will appear on this calendar.

dayAgenda.description: The selected day's events as a time-ordered agenda.
dayAgenda.emptyBody: Events for the selected day will appear here.

scheduleMatrix.description: A resource-by-day shift grid with per-day coverage and a shift legend.
scheduleMatrix.emptyBody: Assigned shifts will appear on this schedule.

capacityBoard.description: Per-member utilization bars with a project breakdown and load status.
capacityBoard.emptyBody: Member utilization will appear here once assignments exist.

masterList.description: A selectable list of records that drives a detail pane.
masterList.emptyBody: Items will appear here once they exist.

logTable.description: An append-only event log with search, an errors filter, and row actions.
logTable.emptyBody: Events will be recorded here as they happen.

cardGallery.description: A responsive gallery of entity cards with status and quick actions.
cardGallery.emptyBody: Items will appear here as cards.

groupedSummaryTable.description: Grouped rows with aggregate columns, expandable details, and totals.
groupedSummaryTable.emptyBody: Grouped totals will appear here once there is data.

schemaTree.description: An explorer for schemas, tables, and columns with type and key badges.
schemaTree.emptyBody: Connect a database to explore its schema here.

toggleMatrix.description: An interactive grid of boolean toggles for roles, policies, or channels.
toggleMatrix.emptyBody: Rows and columns will appear here once configured.

kanbanBoard.description: Fixed status columns of draggable cards; drag a card to another column to update its status.
kanbanBoard.emptyBody: Cards will appear in their status columns as records are created.

kanbanSwimlaneGrid.description: A lane × column grid where dragging a card reassigns both its lane and its status.
kanbanSwimlaneGrid.emptyBody: Group records by a lane field and a status field to build the grid.

a11y.grabbed: Grabbed {title}. Use the arrow keys to move, Enter to drop, Escape to cancel.
a11y.failed: Could not move {title}; it was returned to its original position.

conversationInbox.description: A selectable list of conversations with unread counts, presence, and last-message previews.
conversationInbox.emptyBody: Conversations will appear here as messages arrive.

chatThread.description: Message bubbles grouped by author and day, with attachments and a composer.
chatThread.emptyBody: Messages in this conversation will appear here.

aiChatPanel.description: An assistant panel for asking questions about your schema and data.
aiChatPanel.emptyBody: Ask a question about your schema, tables, or metrics to get started.

orgChart.description: The reporting tree built from a people table's manager reference, with collapsible branches.
orgChart.emptyBody: The org chart appears once people rows reference a manager.

ganttChart.description: Task bars over a time axis, grouped by phase, with progress, milestones, and a today marker.
ganttChart.emptyBody: Tasks appear here once they have start and end dates.

fileBrowser.description: Browse files and folders as a tile grid or a list, with a breadcrumb trail, type icons, and starring.

linkList.description: Reference links with titles and URLs, opening in a new tab.

modalWizard.description: A modal create form with a success confirmation — the standard “new record” flow.

drawerForm.description: A side-drawer create or edit form for records with more fields than a modal fits.

stepper.description: A progress stepper showing where a multi-step flow has got to.

progressBar.description: A determinate progress track with a percent caption.
progressBar.label: Progress

chipInput.description: A tag input: removable chips plus free text that commits on Enter.

segmentedControl.description: A single-select pill control for periods, environments and filters.

filterChipBar.description: Filter chips with live counts computed from the list they filter.

toggleSwitchList.description: A list of settings rows, each with a switch.

optionCards.description: A single-select card grid for sources, templates and plans.

passwordStrengthMeter.description: A four-segment meter showing how strong a password is.

validationIssuesList.description: Import and validation issues, most severe first, with affected row counts.

sidebarNav.description: The grouped app navigation rail, with live count badges.

commandPalette.description: The ⌘K palette: search actions, pages and records from anywhere.

globalSearch.description: Search across every entity, with type facets and result snippets.

breadcrumb.description: The ancestor trail of the current record or folder.

tabBar.description: Tabs that switch panels or navigate, with optional counts.

navCard.description: A grid of link cards for hub and landing pages.
navCard.emptyBody: Hub links appear here once pages are generated.

avatarStack.description: Overlapping avatars with a “+N” overflow and optional presence.

stateHero.description: A full-page status screen for 404, 500, offline, forbidden and maintenance states.

stateHero.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for was moved, renamed, or never existed.
stateHero.serverErrorBody: The error was logged and the team notified. Trying again often works.
stateHero.offlineBody: Check your connection — the dashboard reconnects automatically.
stateHero.forbiddenBody: Ask a workspace admin to grant you permission for this page.
stateHero.maintenanceBody: We are making things better. This usually takes a few minutes.
stateHero.connErrorBody: The connection was refused or timed out. Check the connection settings.

emptyState.description: A centred “nothing here yet” panel with optional actions.

statusPill.description: A tone-coded badge for an enum column — the universal status renderer.

alertBanner.description: An inline callout for quota, freeze and schedule notices.

statusBannerHero.degradedBody: Some services are slower than usual. We are investigating.
statusBannerHero.downBody: One or more services are unavailable. We are on it.

connectionStatus.description: The connect/test result for a database connection.

autosaveIndicator.description: The unsaved → saving → saved pill for autosaving documents.

progressLogConsole.description: A streaming log console with a progress bar, for long-running tasks.
progressLogConsole.emptyBody: Log lines appear here once the task starts.

diagnosticsReadout.description: Connection-check results as toned key/value rows with a freshness stamp.
